rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for an unwise decision, action, or person.

example.english: Quitting your job to travel now is really unwise.
example.traditional: 你而家辭職去旅行，真係唔明智喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 ji4 gaa1 ci4 zik1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zan1 hai6 m4 ming4 zi3 wo3

rows.note: Use this especially for someone who shows poor judgment or fails to think things through.

example.english: They never ask questions before lending people money; they’re really unwise.
example.traditional: 佢借錢畀人之前都唔問清楚，真係唔識諗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ze3 cin2 bei2 jan4 zi1 cin4 dou1 m4 man6 cing1 co2 zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 nam2

rows.note: Use this formal or written equivalent, especially in descriptions of decisions or actions.

example.english: Proceeding with this plan before completing the assessment is unwise.
example.traditional: 喺未完成評估前貿然推行呢項計劃，實屬不智。
example.jyutping: hai2 mei6 jyun4 sing4 ping4 gu2 cin4 mau6 jin4 teoi1 hang4 ne1 hong6 gai3 waak6 sat6 suk6 bat1 zi3
